verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no verification funnel analytics, such as pass rates, drop-off points, or completion time by country or document type. The closest items are adjacent: webhooks and WebSDK event messages are building blocks a developer could use to build such analytics, and the Reusable KYC conversion claim concerns a different feature. Neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see verification funnel analytics — pass rates, drop-off points, completion time by country and document type — to know what verification is costing me in signups
